t: Who is worst in the sight of Allah
a: تَجِدُ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ ذَا الْوَجْهَيْنِ، الَّذِي يَأْتِي هَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ
p: Tajidu min sharri-n-nāsi yawma-l-qiyāmati ʿinda-Llāhi dha-l-wajhayn, alladhī yaʾtī hāʾulāʾi bi-wajh
m: You will find among the worst of people with Allah on the Day of Resurrection the one with two faces, who comes to these with one face,
